description: Client-side script for Purchase Invoice doctype in ERPNext, defining the PurchaseInvoice class with methods for setup, UI interactions, and data handling.

classes.name: PurchaseInvoice
classes.description: Class extending BuyingController, managing Purchase Invoice form behaviors, including setup, refresh, and various actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the PurchaseInvoice form, including indicator formatter and query filters.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Actions to perform when the form loads, such as setting properties and triggering events.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, updates UI elements, and adds custom buttons based on document state.

methods.name: unblock_invoice
methods.description: Calls server method to unblock the invoice.

methods.name: block_invoice
methods.description: Opens dialog to block the invoice with hold reason and release date.

methods.name: change_release_date
methods.description: Opens dialog to set a new release date for the invoice.

methods.name: can_change_release_date
methods.description: Validates if the new release date is in the future.

methods.name: make_comment_dialog_and_block_invoice
methods.description: Creates dialog for blocking invoice with hold details.

methods.name: make_dialog_and_set_release_date
methods.description: Creates dialog for setting a new release date.

methods.name: set_release_date
methods.description: Calls server method to change the release date.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Fetches supplier details and updates form fields accordingly.

methods.name: apply_tds
methods.description: Applies or hides tax withholding category based on apply_tds flag.

methods.name: credit_to
methods.description: Fetches account currency for the credit_to account and updates labels.

methods.name: make_inter_company_invoice
methods.description: Creates inter-company invoice via mapped document.

methods.name: is_paid
methods.description: Handles payment status and updates related fields.

methods.name: write_off_amount
methods.description: Sets write-off amount in company currency and updates outstanding.

methods.name: paid_amount
methods.description: Sets paid amount in company currency and updates outstanding.

methods.name: allocated_amount
methods.description: Calculates total advances and refreshes form.

methods.name: items_add
methods.description: Copies default values to new item row.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Clears purchase receipt references on submit.

methods.name: make_debit_note
methods.description: Creates a debit note via mapped document.
